description: Get every post scheduled between two dates (default: 7 days ago to 30 days ahead), oldest first, with platform, status, time, text, media, first comment and tags — the content calendar view. Optionally only posts with one tag. Needs a plan that includes the content calendar; otherwise it returns an upgrade message.

tag_id.description: Only posts carrying this post tag (UUID).

to.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive (default 30 days from now).

name: get_calendar
